plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git and forge workflow: atomic Conventional Commits, an issue-to-pull-request git-ship skill, and guardrail hooks (no git -C, no commits/pushes on main, origin only, no AI attribution).

plugins.name: docker
plugins.description: Manage Docker containers and Docker Compose services with automatic devcontainer detection and safety constraints. Includes a docker-container skill (docker CLI) and a docker-compose skill (docker compose).

plugins.name: obsidian
plugins.description: Interact with Obsidian vaults via the Obsidian CLI: create, read, search, edit, and restructure notes following the PARA method.

plugins.name: presentation
plugins.description: Presentations in three steps: a drafter for structured outlines (SCR, Patrick Winston's How to Speak), a designer that turns drafts or quick ideas into a slide spec with a grid-first visual system and talk / read modes, and a builder that renders the spec as one shareable HTML file, PDF or PPTX.
